resp is stored as answered (1 to 5), not reverse-scored. Items spa_1, spa_3, spa_7, spa_11, spa_13 and spa_14 are reverse-keyed; score them as 6 - resp before summing. The study's supplement (s002.docx) gives this keying, and it reproduces the published mean (43.21), SD (10.52) and alpha (0.877). Summing the raw values gives SD 9.00 and alpha 0.805.

resp is the raw true/false answer (0/1), not the scored SAD. To reproduce the published SAD total (mean 13.68, SD 7.47, r = 0.195 with expressive suppression), score sad_2, 5, 8, 10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 21, 23, 24 and 26 as 1 - resp and sum all 28. The supplement lists the other 14 items as reverse-scored, and following it gives the mirror score, 28 minus that total, with the correlations' signs flipped.

resp is stored as answered (1 to 5), not reverse-scored. like2, like4 and like6 are negatively worded; score them as 6 - resp before averaging. Done that way, the six-item mean matches the deposit's own video_like composite exactly for all 264 respondents. The raw mean correlates -0.26 with that composite.

resp is stored 1 to 5, as in the deposit (1 = not at all ... 5 = very severe). The published Insomnia Severity Index scores each item 0 to 4. To get the standard 0-28 total and use its cutoffs, subtract 1 from each of the seven items (ISI_1_1, ISI_1_2, ISI_1_3, ISI_2 to ISI_5) before summing.
